WITH feed AS (
            SELECT is_enabled
            FROM feeds
            WHERE id = $1
        ), queued AS (
            INSERT INTO feed_update_queue (feed_id, due_at)
            SELECT $1, NOW()
            FROM feed
            WHERE feed.is_enabled
            ON CONFLICT (feed_id)
            DO UPDATE SET due_at = LEAST(feed_update_queue.due_at, excluded.due_at),
                          updated_at = NOW()
            RETURNING feed_id
        )
        SELECT is_enabled as "is_enabled!: bool"
        FROM feed
